camera_mounting_extrinsics_note: Not supplied by camera-internal calibration; must be obtained from robot mounting calibration or a verified robot model.

capture.gap_note: Sequence gaps observed at the application; not a complete measurement of transport or firmware loss.
capture.latency_note: wait_for_frames wall time measures blocking delivery only. These measurements do not establish exposure-to-consumer latency or robot-camera clock synchronization.
capture.pgm_layout: P5 16-bit big-endian, maximum 65535; values are original Z16 units.
capture.raw_layout: Packed row-major uint16 little-endian; zero is invalid; multiply by depth_scale_m_per_raw_unit for optical-axis Z in meters.

recording.note: This installed RealSense SDK records ROS2 SQLite db3 with original depth frames, stream calibration and timestamps. The scene label is user-provided.

depth_optical_to_color_optical.note: Factory camera-internal transform; NOT the camera-to-robot mounting transform.
